short_description: The soundtrack that belongs to "Chaos Company." Including 10 songs, some alternatives, and very good beats. Genres vary from dubstep, to jukebox, to classical, to dubstep again. Some tracks as short as 40 seconds, and some tracks as long as 7 and a half minutes. Overall, a good OST to listen to.
